correctness.rationale: The path grounded Green kernel G(i,k)=min(i,k) is verified by direct multiplication. Sherman–Morrison gives the exact trace change with positive denominator. The adjacent delta identity has a positive term and a weight-linear term whose unique nonnegative-root cutoffs occur only at j≥ceil((6n−1)/8); these rational thresholds strictly decrease in j by monotonic numerator and denominator, yielding a complete adjacent-tie staircase for all n≥3 and all positive real edge weights. The derivative of the uniform large-n limit has one root on (3/4,1); for fixed positive conductance the thresholds force optimal position/n→3/4 and normalized residual→1/4. The standalone source path verify.py was executed and passed 60,096 exact checks including independent rational matrix inversion; finite checks are not used as proof of infinitely many cases.

value.rationale: A natural, published social-network control intervention—adding one weighted contact from a stubborn leader on a long noisy communication chain—has no location rule independent of conductance. The result gives every exact threshold and unique/tied optimizer for all chain sizes, as well as a non-obvious three-quarter asymptotic location and sharp 75-percent total-noise variance reduction. The all-parameter structural classification is mathematically informative and benchmarks exact one-link intervention heuristics, beyond isolated numerical evaluation or arbitrary parameter cuts.
